description: YHWaterstop rubber series are made from natural rubber or EPDM rubber, with various accelerators and fillers added. Manufactured via plasticization, compounding, vulcanization and forming by extrusion or compression moulding, this strip-shaped rubber product leverages rubber's high elasticity and shrinkage characteristics.
whereToUse: They are designed to be the effective sealing of concrete expansion/movement, construction and connection joints in structures, such as water reservoirs, sewage treatment plants, swimming pools, basements, retaining walls, lift shafts, tunnels, culverts, etc.
Pre-embedded within construction and movement joints during concrete placement, it bonds monolithically with concrete
The internal waterstops are embedded at the middle of concrete joints for all internal construction and expansion joints
Back-mounted waterstops are attached to the outer water-facing surface as the first external waterproof barrier, mainly applied above blinding slabs and outside tunnel primary supports
advantages: High elasticity, abrasion, ageing and tear resistance, good deformation adaptability, wide working temperature (-45℃ ~ +60℃) and reliable waterproofing
Optimized cross-section: separate load-bearing and waterproof zones for balanced stress distribution
Designed rib profiles provide barriers to water migration
Secure installation: smooth expansion cavity for stable formwork clamping
notFor: Sharp aggregates and rebar ends inside concrete may cause damage
As the tear strength of rubber and plastic is only 1/3-1/5 of its tensile strength, any puncture or tear will propagate easily under minor load
Avoid prolonged direct sunlight exposure, keep rain protection, and isolate from aggressive chemicals
Prevent mechanical and rebar damage during transport and construction
Securely fix the waterstop to maintain its designed position against displacement during concrete placement
Drilling/penetration is only permitted on the edge fixing zone; the sealing body shall not be damaged
Order length shall be calculated per structural drawings. Prefabricated joints in factory are preferred

standards.value: Tensile strength 16 MPa (±5%), elongation at break 300 % (±5%)

technicalData.label: Fixing options
technicalData.value: auxiliary rebar, special clamps, steel cable + formwork

technicalData.label: On-site joints

storage: The product should be stored in ventilated places, with no exposure to sunlight, rain, or fire. The storage temperature should be between 5 °C and 30 °C. The shelf life is at least 24 months under normal transportation and storage conditions.
